Record Class OidcTokenResult.Issued

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
iu.oidc.provider.OidcTokenResult.Issued
Record Components:
accessToken - access_token
tokenType - token_type, always Bearer
expiresIn - expires_in, in seconds
scope - scope actually granted, space-delimited, which may be narrower than what was asked for
idToken - id_token; null when none was issued
refreshToken - refresh_token; null when none was issued
authorizationDetails - authorization_details the grant released, which RFC 9396 §7 has the response state since what was granted may be narrower than what was asked for; null when the grant released none
All Implemented Interfaces:
OidcTokenResult
Enclosing interface:
OidcTokenResult
public static record OidcTokenResult.Issued(String accessToken, String tokenType, long expiresIn, String scope, String idToken, String refreshToken, Iterable<? extends edu.iu.jwt.IuAuthorizationDetails> authorizationDetails) extends Record implements OidcTokenResult
Tokens were issued; answer 200.

idToken is set only when openid was granted, and only for a grant that answers for an end user; refreshToken only when offline_access was granted and the original authentication is young enough for one to be worth issuing. Both are null otherwise and are left out of the response document rather than written empty.
